blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — INQUIRER.net assignment editor and longtime judiciary reporter Ma. Theresa “Tetch” Torres-Tupas was among prominent journalists honored by Icons of Change as part of its 2026 cohort, alongside BBC World Service correspondent Mike Thomson and award-winning investigative journalist Chris Rogers. Torres-Tupas was recognized as a 2026 Changemaker for Ethical Legal Journalism under the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goal 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions. She has covered the judiciary beat for INQUIRER.net for decades and currently serves as the news website’s assignment editor.
